subject: SEO Update — ARLO — 2026-09-28
html:
SE Ranking stayed authenticated for another session (site_id 12704162 confirmed live). A fresh pull on the FOCUS cluster (MCP-integration keywords) and the destinations-catalog gate found nothing new — 9th consecutive session confirming the connector matrix and comparison hub are fully built out, with every remaining gap (Meta Ads, HubSpot, Stripe, Shopify, Excel, Snowflake MCP/destinations) still gated on an overdue catalog.ts/destinations-catalog entry. With FOCUS, destinations, and blog all re-confirmed exhausted, this session re-read the site's own technical and structured-data audits end-to-end against current code (not just the 2026-07-04 audit text) and found one real, previously unfixed gap: two live, correctly-built pages — /privacy and /terms — have never been listed in sitemap.xml, even though both resolve fine and already have correct canonical tags. Two other audit line items turned out to be false alarms on closer inspection (already fixed, or referring to routes that no longer exist) and were not touched.

/privacy, /termsAdded both URLs to sitemap.xml (they existed and worked, but were simply never listed for Google to discover via the sitemap).N/A — indexation-completeness fix, no new keyword targetedaskarlo.app/sitemap.xml — search for /privacy and /terms

Rankings/backlinks (fresh pull): avg position still flat at 100 (0 of 22 tracked keywords ranked) every day this week — unchanged since kickoff. Backlinks holding at 3 backlinks / 2 referring domains, flat for the 3rd straight week. AI Result Tracker still has zero LLM engines configured — no AI-visibility baseline yet (needs a human to set up). catalog.ts and the destinations catalog re-checked: all 8 gated connectors and the gated destinations (Excel, Snowflake, Redshift, Databricks, Notion, Airtable) remain unchanged, none flipped live.

Next: Both content engines (MCP-integration keywords, destinations comparisons) remain genuinely exhausted — the next real content opportunity is either a catalog.ts connector shipping or a destination flipping from coming-soon to live. On the technical side, the site's own audits are now mostly closed out after this session's pass; the next open item is IndexNow (needs a human decision, since it requires a live outbound ping this sandbox can't make). Off-page directory listings and Google Search Console sitemap submission also remain human-gated, unchanged.
